behaviors.description: App process-group signals must not reach the host supervisor.
behaviors.preconditions: A guarded private-session supervisor catches SIGCONT and first verifies its handler with a direct signal; the app catches the same signal. SIGCONT is harmless to bubblewrap's supervisor, which may share the inner process group.
behaviors.expected: Both kill(0, SIGCONT) and killpg(0, SIGCONT) deliver inside the app and complete without signaling its host supervisor.

notes: The supervisor refuses to run unless it leads its own private session/group. It never signals the runner's group. No requirement denominator is added.
